scope: Descriptor-relative owned diagnostic acquisition only; trusted roots supplied later by independently reviewed launcher. Source-only review, not a live observer acceptance or native launch approval.

tests.kind: independent tiny owned host path and fault probes

cases.case: Census PID 41 is symlink to sibling directory
Create cgroup child after process_snapshot and before final census check
Rewrite own synthetic PID stat start from 900 to 901 after first read
Inject KeyboardInterrupt during directory iteration and OSError on iterator close
cases.outcome: BaseExceptionGroup preserves identical primary and cleanup exceptions in order; close attempted once; borrowed roots remain valid

cases.case: Rename pinned cgroup and replace original path
cases.outcome: Pinned fd reads original bytes; fresh no-follow path walk rejects directory_identity

assessment: Absolute directory path validation rejects empty, dot, dotdot and overlong components/paths before opens; single-component O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW traversal confines descriptor acquisition.
Fixed filename allowlist and caps prevent arbitrary-name reads. File O_NONBLOCK permits FIFO type rejection without waiting for a writer; regular-file validation precedes bounded reading.
Child census streams at most 65 entries, freshly stats only first 64 without following links, and fails on lookup/iteration errors, directories or symlinks.
Only parsed census PIDs are opened; PID stat identity/start and cgroup membership are double-checked, while attribution remains owned_unattributed.
Cleanup attempts are ordered and not retried; partial acquisition and combined primary/cleanup failures fail closed. Python >=3.11 is required for approved BaseExceptionGroup handling.
limitations: Native Linux proc/cgroup filesystems were not exercised. Host fixtures establish helper behavior only.

Pinned dev/inode/uid/mode does not establish current pathname, mount identity, boot/container epoch or trusted launch ownership. Boundary rewalk and fstat checks remain required in future composition.
Discrete checks cannot exclude transient rename/ABA, membership transitions or concurrent child creation/removal between observations.
O_NONBLOCK is FIFO-open protection, not a deadline for arbitrary regular files or filesystems. Mount custody remains a native preflight obligation.
No live entrypoint, marker/ACK integration, exception-to-bounded-reason serializer, epoch binding or shared-output custody is approved by this review.
No source/index modifications, native proc sampling, VM/SDK execution, installs, external service changes or process control performed. Nine unrelated drafts preserved.

resources.note: Synthetic temp fixtures cleaned after checks; only this exclusive review report retained.
